sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Brunswick Selectboard members: David Caron, Robert Hook, and Darcy Smart. Brunswick has no official town website; the directory is the official roster of record.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Sharon Graham as Town Clerk of Brunswick and as Town Treasurer of Brunswick.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Brunswick justices of the peace: Claudette Hook, Laurence Hook, Jr., Sharon Graham, Crystal Meunier, and Deborah Tetreault. Claudette Hook and Laurence Hook, Jr. are distinct persons from Selectboard member Robert Hook.
